title: Blank Data Model
description: <keyword>Hostile Neural Networks</keyword> allows you to train <keyword>data models</keyword> and run <property>simulations</property>, producing <keyword>mob predictions</keyword>, which can be used to generate mob loot.

The fundamental unit of this mod is the <keyword>Data Model</keyword> - an item which holds information about an entity that you can utilize to generate their drops. To get a Data Model, you must first craft a <keyword>Data Model Framework</keyword>, and <positive>use it on the target entity</positive> to build the model. Once you have your model, you will have to train it.
